target_customer: Corporate buyers of carbon removal credits and landowners with degraded land
problem: Reforestation on poor land grows slowly; the company uses photosynthesis-enhanced poplar trees to raise biomass and sell carbon removal.
business_model: Carbon credit sales and land restoration projects, plus biomass supply
product_category: Synthetic biology for carbon removal and reforestation

founders.name: Maddie Hall
founders.background_notes: YC page and AgFunder name her CEO; no background given there.

technical_complexity.rationale: Engineering trees for higher photosynthetic efficiency needs plant genetics, field trials and regulatory clearance, at research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary engineered lines and approvals are hard to copy quickly; long field trial timelines slow rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied the wedge in sources found; large buyers became customers (Microsoft agreement April 2025 per the company site).

market_need_then: Corporate demand for carbon removal credits was rising; AgFunder says the Series A would fund 4 to 5 million seedlings (January 2023).

branding.community_and_virality: Wide press coverage (CBS, Scientific American, TechCrunch, MIT Technology Review) about the engineered trees.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable supertrees story with national press, but the name itself is generic and no mascot or community found.

outcome_analysis: Living Carbon raised a Temasek led $21M Series A in January 2023 with total funding stated at $36M, then signed offtake deals with Microsoft in 2025 and a $500M project commitment from Octopus Energy Generation in April 2026. Success rests on proprietary engineered trees and corporate carbon removal demand, with regulatory and public acceptance risk.
notes: AgFunder total of $36M implies about $15M earlier; one outlet says a $15M round led by Felicis in February 2022, but that was not confirmed with a source that states it, so the gap is noted not recorded. Octopus: press release says commitment of $500M to projects and nearly $13M into the business (amount via search summary, stage not stated, labelled other); this is not equity funding of $500M. A co-founder named Patrick Mellor appears in one search summary but no YC or company page I opened lists him. A $500K DOE grant in 2021 is only in a directory. No competitor with a source near 2020 found.
